component.name: Yandex Music Native
Яндекс Музыка (нативный)
component.summary: Native Linux client for Yandex Music

description.p: Lightweight native desktop client for Yandex Music built with PySide6 (Qt 6), libmpv and NumPy. No Electron, no WebView.
Лёгкий нативный клиент Яндекс Музыки на PySide6 (Qt 6), libmpv и NumPy. Без Electron и WebView.

First stable release: the yamusic package is gone, the application is the core (auth, audio, playback, Yandex service, desktop) plus ui (PySide6 shell) stack, with 60 FPS visualizers and validated «Моя волна» settings.
